items.name: Royal Navy Carriers Operate in the High North, Mediterranean
items.summary: Royal Navy aircraft carrier HMS Prince of Wales (R09) is conducting operations across the High North as HMS Queen Elizabeth (RO8) trains in the Mediterranean. Prince of Wales recently participated in a U.S.-led nuclear command and control exercise near Norway while aircraft carrier Queen Elizabeth carried out interoperability exercises with Royal Air Force Chinook heavy lift helicopters off Gibraltar.
